wheel_model.invariance: base plus four wheel links preserves the original 10.004 kg mass, CG and aggregate inertia

open_yaw.description: unchanged wheel-speed loop with kinematic open-loop yaw target

gyro_yaw.description: body angular velocity is the simulated gyro signal; PI yaw-rate outer loop commands the existing wheel-speed loops

interpretation_rules: all mu values are reported; no convenient value is selected
a Coulomb pass is only a necessary quasi-static screen, not proof of turning
wheel spin below motor saturation is expected when commanded tyre torque exceeds mu*Nwheel*radius
gyro feedback may improve tracking but cannot create missing tyre friction
Gazebo joint wrench is a load input for FEA; it is not a printed-strength result
